stories.title: Salah scores two goals, has two disallowed in first start for Trabzonspor
stories.summary: Salah started his first game for the Turkish Super Lig side, whom he joined on a free transfer earlier this month. Mohamed Salah opened his account in the Turkish Super Lig with a double as Trabzonspor beat Istanbul Basaksehir 2-1 to clinch their first win of the season. Salah, who joined Trabzonspor on a free transfer after leaving Liverpool following a trophy-laden nine-year spell, also had two goals disallowed in a standout performance on Sunday. Making his first league start after appearing as a substitute in Trabzonspor’s season opener, Salah put his side ahead in the eighth minute, capitalising after Basaksehir goalkeeper Muhammed Sengezer failed to hold on to the ball. Basaksehir’s Eldor Shomurodov equalised from the penalty spot in the 19th minute, but Salah restored Trabzonspor’s lead three minutes into the second half, bursting down the right, exchanging passes with Ernest Muci and slotting the ball into the far corner. The 34-year-old winger had a stoppage-time effort chalked off for a foul in the build-up and another ruled out for offside when he found the empty net from long range with the goalkeeper upfield for a corner. He will now turn his attention to Thursday’s Europa League playoff second leg away to Ferencvaros after his side suffered a 1-0 home defeat in the first leg.
